notes.title: Important News Regarding Save Compatibility with the Upcoming Co-op Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone. I’m Wojtek Liwanowski, and I’m a Producer here on Forever Skies.

As we are deep into our current beta tests, I want to address an important change regarding the compatibility of your current Early Access saves with our upcoming update, which will, among many other things, add co-op. We know this news might come as a disappointment, but we want to be transparent and honest with you as soon as possible.

OLD SAVES WILL BECOME INCOMPATIBLE WITH THE NEXT 1.7.0 UPDATE

Up until now, we’ve worked extremely hard to ensure that each update we released kept your save games compatible. Each time, it’s been a challenge, but we’ve managed to make it work. We’ve always prioritized this, knowing just how much time and effort many of you have invested in your airship builds. We approached this new update with the same intention - to preserve your saves. However, after months of testing, redesigning, and QA, we’ve come to the glaring conclusion that, no matter how hard we try, the next update has evolved the game so much - both in terms of new features and changes to core systems - that old saves will no longer be compatible. So, with the next 1.7.0 update coming in a few weeks, we will have to ask everyone to start the game from a fresh save.

EXISTING SAVES ARE CREATING TOO MANY CONFLICTS

While it’s easy for us to simply say this is how things are, we think, if you ask any of our current beta testers, they’ll likely tell you the same thing: the way you progress now is vastly different from how it was before. Tools that you previously had to find in the world are now given to you at the start. Key airship expansion moments tied to the story progress have been reshuffled. Several mechanics have been tweaked, removed, or replaced with new ones.

The list goes on. Each of these changes creates its own set of logical conflicts between how the game is now and the near-infinite possibilities of where your old save might have been, dating all the way back to June 2023. Essentially, it has become nearly impossible for us to account for every "before and after" state a save could be in to ensure compatibility once the new gameloop is added.

COULD WE HAVE DONE THINGS DIFFERENTLY?

Could we have handled this differently? Yes, of course. One option would have been to leave the game as it is. If we had decided that continuing to support existing saves was the top priority, we would have ultimately concluded that we couldn’t move forward with many of these exciting and much-needed changes. But these changes were directly driven by feedback from you, our community, and have been made with the sole purpose of improving the overall gameplay experience - for both single-player and co-op play.

Maybe if we were a team in the 100’s we could have brute-forced these issues and fixed the slew of problems that would have cropped up after the update went live. But we are  20 developers on this game, the idea of releasing an update that we know would cause both you and us more frustration than enjoyment is just an awful idea.

PART OF WHAT EARLY ACCESS IS FOR

Why we opted for Early Access in the first place was always so that the game could evolve with the help of you, our players. But with that development choice came the risk that a hard reset might be necessary. We understand that this is far from ideal, and we’re extremely sorry that it has come to this. Please believe me when I say that everyone on our team did everything possible to avoid this situation for as long as we could while still improving the game. We explored fixes and workarounds right up until this week, before finally deciding that we had no other option but to accept the situation. So, we wanted to inform you as soon as we knew with 100% certainty that this is now our only choice. We also wanted to share this information with any new players who might be picking up the game now or during the upcoming Steam Autumn Sale.

A SMALL TOKEN OF THANKS

As a gesture of thanks for your understanding and to properly honor the airships you’ve built in Early Access, we will be creating a special poster and in-game artifact to commemorate your past journeys. These will be added in a future update after co-op, and we hope they will serve as a special reminder of your past adventures and contributions to the game’s development as you dive back in to experience the next - and final - evolution of the game.

Since we only agreed this week for certain that you'll need to start fresh saves, these items are still just ideas on paper so we don't have anything to show. But rest assured we'll be making this something special for all of you.

THANK YOU FOR BEING YOU

We deeply appreciate all the support we’ve received as we continue to refine and evolve Forever Skies. The feedback we’ve gotten from the beta has been extremely positive, and when we asked many of you if you’re okay with needing to restart your progress, there was a near-unanimous consensus that you understand why and are happy to do so, given how much has changed. Feedback like this is invaluable to us, as it shows that our community understands the complexities of game development and are behind us. We know we're not the first game ever to hit this speed bump and we know others in the future will have the same. But what was important to us was hearing your thoughts and reassurance on this.

We can’t wait to share this new update with you in the next few weeks. We’re still doing tests, but as mentioned previously, we plan to have this update in your hands by the end of the year.

Thank you again, and we’ll see you in our reimagined skies soon.

- Wojtek

*EDIT TO POST*
LEGACY BRANCH TO ACCESS YOUR OLD SAVES

In the comments of this post, FS Community member “Mickjay” and others requested if the game in it’s current EA.1.6.0 form could be kept separate in a new branch so players could still access their OG Airship builds even after the change and reset with EA.1.7.0. Quite frankly, we thought this was an AWESOME idea.

We will create a separate branch on Steam with the game as it is right now. So, if you'd like to return to your existing airship using your old save, you can access it there.

However, please keep in mind that this branch won’t receive any future updates or new content moving forward. It’s simply there for those of you who want to revisit your past saves and progress before all the changes we’ve made reshaped the game.

notes.title: Bug Hotfix Now Live!
notes.notes:
Greetings scientists,

We have just sent out a hotfix that addresses a few key visual bugs, crashes and more. Here is the changelog:

CHANGED:

 The “Send Feedback” button now opens the Feature Upvote report site and automatically adds crucial information to the description.

FIXED:

 Fixed an issue where the Dust layer disappeared after travelling a certain distance.
 Added icon for Wrecked Amber King Size Bed’s scan info.
 Fixed an occasional crash while moving certain critical devices between Inventory slots.
 Fixed a crash that occurred when the player tried to relocate the Organic Printer in the Underdust locations’ Lifts
 Fixed a crash that occurred sometimes when the player was removing modules using the Build Tool.
 Fixed an issue where the Organic Printer was showing 0% health.
 Fixed Wrecked Distiller typo in the Database.
 Fixed an issue with Combat quests for players who finished the story before the Combat Update. The quest previously called for harvesting Dust Firecracker on the New Nature Territory location, which isn’t there.

KNOWN ISSUES: 

 Charged Growth Blockade’s material doesn’t show that it can be scanned.
 “Inventory Full” error message can sometimes stay on the screen.
 Sometimes using Deck Extractor for a longer period of time separates player’s mesh from player’s camera - it gets back to normal upon disengaging from Deck Extractor.
 Sometimes the airship is not responding to handling its controls - the quickest way to solve this is to leave an airship completely and return.
 Its rare, but occasionally using the Knife consumes all stamina at once - we’re investigating this issue.
 Locations shouldn’t spawn near or in the mountains anymore, any further problems with it happening should be investigated as a separate issue.
 Some players may experience black screen when starting a new game instead of the game’s intro. To fix this, go to the NVIDIA Control Panel, then to “Manage 3D Settings” and look for “VSync.” Then, change the “VSync” setting to “Off.”
 There is an issue where players see high-contrast colours during a storm due to virus post-process effects. This happens if the player character was previously infected with Meningitis.


There will more fixes and QoL improvements coming soon. Thank you for your reports, keep 'em coming!

- Team Far From Home

notes.title: The Combat Update Is Now Live!
notes.notes:
Greetings scientists…

The day has finally arrived, our Combat Update is out of beta and is now playable for all on Steam Early Access!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/2c6fb8fc6ee40908b65267791d3d3d180dc30429.png

EA.1.6.0 is packed with content. Including a new location type, with two variants, combat mechanics, new resources, story route changes, artifact trading & reward system, performance improvements, bug fixes, and QoL improvements, including the two highest-voted requests on Feature Upvote, moving full storage boxes and suit upgrades! Check out the combat trailer to get your first look.

[previewyoutube=EQrIsVMc_Sk;full][/previewyoutube]

DISCOUNT AND YOUR FAV BUNDLES
First off though, as part of this update, we've made Forever Skies 25% off. We've also partnered with our friends at Sengoku Dynasty, Survival: Fountain of Youth and Volcanoids to create some great survival game bundles.

If you already own any of the above games, you can get an extra 10% off Forever Skies or vice versa. Already got Forever Skies? Then check out the bundles to get an extra discount on any of these three games!

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/44700/Survival_Fountain_of_Youth_x_Forever_Skies/
Survival: Fountain of Youth is a challenging single-player open-world adventure game set on the Caribbean islands. Survive as a shipwrecked 16th-century explorer, craft tools and shelter, and uncover the secrets of both an ancient civilization and your own fate.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/44627/Sengoku_Dynasty_x_Forever_Skies/
In Sengoku Dynasty, build and manage villages in an open-world feudal Japan. Survive, explore, meet unique characters, and establish your legacy. Play solo or in co-op multiplayer.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/41771/Volcanoids_x_Forever_Skies/
Volcanoids is a base-building open-world survival shooter that replaces your typical base with a giant drill. Alone or with friends, explore an island plagued by eruptions, upgrade your drill, and fight robots to uncover what's been hiding beneath the surface.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------

INTRODUCING COMBAT MECHANICS

As always, we recommend starting a new game with this update, as EA.1.6.0 makes significant changes to the “golden path” in the game, which becomes apparent towards the end of your first visit to the Underdust.

After failing to enter the Infected Garden, players are now tasked with finding ingredients for the Immunity Booster at two different locations nearby. Players also now only need to visit the one Infected Garden, as we felt that visiting three was overkill.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/db1237a00470149e9d94510a2627cba25176d580.gif

The two Dust Territories, Wild Habitat and New Nature, are slightly different to any other location you have previously visited. You will land on them with your airship just like any other tower above the dust, but it won’t be long before you descend into the smog on foot!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/55f46baf3f7a95ede6932bd14273477fcbeb749e.gif

The Crossbow has received an overhaul with new SFX, a new reload animation and an advanced model with better handling and more bolts per round.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/b9ccefbbef0c8ac29e8e444f6c03b19b9e663cc7.gif
Our Animator, Adam, prototyping the new reload animation with items from around the studio and also the final look

As well as the standard Crossbow Bolts, players will also be able to get their hands on Poison Bolts, Charged Bolts, and Charged Mines, giving them quite a few options when facing hostiles.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/5dde867956b8b21d4e4562eb27bb1a8c2a56019d.gif

But we also understand that not every player wants to engage in lethal combat, as such there are a few passive ways to deal with threats. Players will be able to craft Decoys and Stunning Traps to overcome enemies non-lethally.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/5fd99b50918b7dfcc440c8116e13effa4586d6ee.gif

Combat has also been added to the Underdust - Suburbs location as we originally promised when we released the Gardening Update back in Spring. If players choose not to start a new game to experience the story changes and have completed all current objectives, then a unique quest will be available where you can experience some of the new content via that quest

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/9a62c5c4904cd84d78d742797667854321637503.gif

ARTIFACT TRADING STATIONS

Before the collapse of humanity, smugglers resided within these territories to hoard artifacts of the old world they believed still carried value. Here, in the vaults of these Dust Territories, players will discover a brand new mechanic, Artifact Trading Stations.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/1bd26b53904c49a4f46d2cfa483d55cc734c3b13.png

Here, you can bring all of the excess old-world artifacts you’ve found and trade them in for other items to complete your collection. 

Earn Tech Fragments to increase your Trading XP which unlocks new reward tiers. You can even unlock upgrade blueprints for you, your pet companion or your airship here. FINALLY, a use for those 60 “Join Project Oxygen” posters you’ve been hoarding.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/091fae77a4fa3e7f3e3761ca6cdbf7be54015c21.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/6b58b0f125f3701ed70c02ac4cee589f72058d85.png

WHAT ELSE IS IN THE COMBAT UPDATE?

1. Suit upgrades such as armor and backpack levels 1-3 can now be discovered and unlocked. These have dedicated slots in your inventory. This was the most popular request on our Feature Upvote site!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/ddeba6bf8a142c1698e554eff1597e5894af2f3e.png

2. Moving full storage boxes QoL feature is available with EA.1.6.0! Players can now move Storage Boxes with contents wherever they like onboard their Airship, making customization easier than ever. This will also work with Freezers and Cookers containing food and Engines containing fuel. This was the second most popular request on Feature Upvote, and we’re excited to make this live for all!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/f891c35cee612d4855012e4f30151713c99de50f.gif

3. Two new outfits for the Friendly Insect, Camo Gear in the traditional green and in black.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/1727a10bc2c9636795ed62769b56e4e2f3cdb6c6.gif

Here is a little bug buddy tribute to remind you to never go into the ruins alone.

[previewyoutube=nhmqzNwb9Pw;full][/previewyoutube]

4. A radial menu is now available by holding down “C”. Use this to quickly access different ammo types, health, food and water.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/248e071d4ef96bee2b9377c3a387ad14a266ab57.gif

5. A whole new range of Retro-Futuristic furniture is now available to craft. Oh, and that periodic poster you all wanted for your airship can now be picked up from the labs in the Infected Garden.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/1293b1eafa032706868ac612563239b48baa18e0.png

notes.title: News on the Upcoming Combat Update - Beta Content - Win a Steam Gift Card
notes.notes:
Greetings scientists!

We’ve just pushed a massive amount of content and changes to our Beta Branch which you can now play for yourself.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/fb4c40fccd783ec8bb3dc006a0e6fd6e2537b6e7.gif

Some of you have noticed that this beta has lasted a little longer than previous ones. We’ve been cooking some changes to what we first released based on your initial feedback.

We also wanted to try reward players willing to come back and give us more feedback which you can read about below. So let's get into what we’ve been up to.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/60c662c1703cc76bd8288887fc5358fdf3f99fcb.gif

WHY WE'RE TAKING MORE TIME WITH COMBAT

Back in late July, we launched the beta for our next update. The overall sentiment from players was that it was fine and that we added some decent content to the overall game loop.

However, we felt we wanted to create something a little better than just "fine". We genuinely value and take into account player feedback so we saw this as another chance to truly show that. We went over all beta gameplay feedback again and together the team mapped out what additions and improvements could be made with an extra month of development time. 

We’ve made some massive changes and feel we’ve added some great features and changes not just to combat, but the whole game loop. 

WHAT IS BEING ADDED/CHANGED?

The changes/additions we decided to implement can be sorted into 1 of 3 major categories:

1. Combat Overhaul
Improvements to Crossbow, ammo types and traps. Suit upgrades - armor and backpacks. Mantis has improved player tracking, logic with new attacks and animations, including a ranged attack.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/93c72547a3a7e92ee41ddf9b0e03958b05e59de1.gif

2. New Locations Overhaul 
Mantis “arena” completely revamped from scratch, expanding the size & scale of the area. Visual improvements made to both new locations, making them easier to navigate. New high-voltage gates added to locations.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/83e7c7656d3389294ff038c4de39eca628ce68f1.gif

3. New Mechanic (Scavengers Printer)
A completely new mechanic/system was added to both new locations. Trade artifacts found in the world for others to complete your collection. Earn “Tech Sliver” to increase your Prestige and unlock new reward tiers.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/b9b510de05f27c4dd0df082f0e4d9dc4ff4dcc76.png

You can see the full breakdown in the patch notes further below.

SOME ADDITIONS TO THE BETA ARE WORK IN PROGRESS

While playing the beta you will notice that some elements are whiteboxes/missing textures, which while they function as intended, still don’t have the finished visuals, textures etc. We wanted to test this content with our players sooner than later to see if we’ve hit the mark so we decided to release this to testing now. Rest assured, missing textures will be added very soon. 

At this stage, we're mostly interested in your feedback about the changes to combat and all the new content additions, (listed below) and less interested in bug reports. Gameplay feedback is the priority right now.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/9f4a812afe56034b7d050b1f445b19befd204b96.gif
Backpack tiers and armor can now be discovered and unlocked in the new locations.

NEW UPDATE RELEASE WINDOW

With all these additions, changes, and additional time for community feedback, we of course needed some extra development time. We opted to give the part of our team working on this the whole of August to make these improvements. 

Therefore as it stands, this update will launch into the main game in early September. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/41ca68e86c40cb6467d3fc001898913cb610ee39.gif
Use Charged Bolts to clear pathways blocked by Growth Gates

SEND FEEDBACK AND STAND A CHANCE TO WIN 1 OF 10 STEAM GIFT CARDS WORTH 25 USD

We know that taking time out to provide in-depth feedback is time-consuming, especially for content we've had available for some time now. 

So as a thank you to those who are helping us make the game better for everyone, we have put together a raffle where 10 beta testers who fill out the feedback form for the latest beta update will be sent a digital Steam gift card equivalent to 25 USD

REQUIREMENTS:

Please play the latest beta update and when once you have experienced the bulk of it fill out this feedback form

➡️https://forms.gle/PW9kYc7MjGdVktBx9⬅️

HOW ARE WINNERS SELECTED?

We will select 10 survey participants at random and will assess their feedback to see if feels legit and was filled in with actual intent and thought. So please don't just give everything a 10/10 as this will indicate to us this wasn't filled out with thought or intention to help. 

The 10 winners will then be contacted by us via Steam where they will need to accept a friend request from one of our dev accounts. 

STEAM PROFILE REQUIREMENTS EXPLAINED:

In the survey you see we are asking you to provide your Steam username and set your  Steam profile to public. We are doing to so that we can:

1. Be sure you own Forever Skies
2. Can see the number of hours you've played in total
3. Allow us to send you your Steam Gift card

We are doing this to avoid rewarding people who simply submit answers to try win the gift cards and also to ensure we can get you your gift card if you are selected.

Details on how to change your profile privacy settings are here: 
https://help.steampowered.com/en/faqs/view/588C-C67D-0251-C276 

If you are not open to changing your profile to public for the duration of this raffle, we totally understand and you are of course still welcome to provide feedback on the beta. However, if your name is picked in the raffle we will need to pick someone else in your place if we can't find and view your Steam profile. 

----------------------------------------------------------------------

notes.title: Combat Update (EA.1.6.0) NOW LIVE ON BETA
notes.notes:
Greetings scientists…

As per the title, the Combat Update is now live on our beta branch and can be played RIGHT NOW!

EA.1.6.0 features two new location variants, combat mechanics, new resources, story route changes, performance improvements, bug fixes, and a few QoL improvements, including the highest-voted request on Feature Upvote regarding moving storage boxes! 

More cool items will be added when the Combat Update goes live on the main branch, but for now let's get stuck into what you can expect from the update in beta.

 🔽Combat Feedback Survey🔽

https://forms.gle/mTj9K4Hm8wEnLN6G6 

Our team put a lot of work into the combat aspect of this update, so we're asking our avid beta testers to please fill our survey after playing. 

This way we can dig deeper into your feedback and thoughts on how the game is shaping up.

Introducing Combat & Changes To Story

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/35b672eb8cc7904e82b6da39206c207008de3aa1.gif

As always, we recommend starting a new game with this latest update, as EA.1.6.0 makes significant changes to the “golden path” in the game, which becomes apparent towards the end of your first visit to the Underdust.

Previously players had to find ingredients such as the Mantis Glands, Dust Daisies or Patats, and a Medical Reagent to make an Immunity Booster to enter 3 different Infected Garden locations to acquire the research on the cure, this is no longer the case with the EA.1.6.0 update…

After failing to enter the Infected Garden, players are now tasked with finding ingredients for the Immunity Booster at two different locations nearby. Players also now only need to visit the one Infected Garden, instead of three.

The two new locations are Underdust variants but with a slight difference. There are no surface lifts in sight here. Instead, you will be descending on foot! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/18186ff30c27f9463af159a538c3ee339eb886b3.gif

The Crossbow has received an overhaul with new sound effects and a reload animation. As well as the standard Crossbow Bolts, players will also be able to get their hands on Poison Bolts, Explosive Bolts, and Throwable Mines, giving them quite a few options when facing hostiles. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/0f7bcd8202c29f96926681d3efd8d50e79f21b5a.gif

But we also understand that not every player wants to engage in lethal combat, as such there are a few passive ways to deal with threats, players will also be able to craft Chirping Decoys and Stunning Traps to overcome enemies non-lethally.

If players choose not to start a new game to experience  the story changes, and have completed all current objectives, then a unique quest will be available where you can experience some of the new content.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/ebc39e690ea38c65b232711c0de2e29d826a1afc.gif

The challenge level in these locations is based on your difficulty settings, but will also get harder as you progress the story. So be sure to craft plenty of Oxygen Boosters, Endurance Boosters and Blood Coagulator Boosters if you plan to head to other “Combat Arena’s”, they’re sure to come in handy. 

Finally, combat has been added to the Underdust - Suburbs location as we originally promised when we released the Gardening Update back in Spring.

Moving Filled Storage Boxes & More

At the time of writing, the suggestion to move Storage Boxes is sat at the top of the pile of your feature requests with 500 upvotes on our Feature Upvote Site.
We are excited to announce that this QoL feature is available with EA.1.6.0! Players can now move Storage Boxes with contents and move them wherever they like onboard their Airship, making customization easier than ever. Just hold down Q on the box you want to move and a “ghost” of the storage box will be created in your hands. Simply place it in your chosen spot and the box and its contents will be instantly transported! This will also work with Freezers and Cookers containing food and Engines containing fuel.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/f891c35cee612d4855012e4f30151713c99de50f.gif

We have worked on overall performance in the game as many had reported a significant drop in frames while playing. Please let us know how the game is running for you now!

We’ve also added a Quick Select Wheel menu to make your life a little easier (very handy when fending off a deadly Mantis), eating and drinking animations and Airship Builder crafting from storage QoL among other additions. And you can expect even more items when we come out of beta!

IMPORTANT REMINDER

If the game is played from an older save (from the ending of the 1st Underdust questline up to creating the Evolved Flora Hologram), some issues might appear in the progression. We recommend starting a new save or playing on a save in which the main questline has already been completed to avoid these problems.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
How To Access the Test Branch


 Open the Steam application on your PC and locate Forever Skies in your games library
 Right click - PROPERTIES- BETAS
 Put in the password: BlimpWorkshop
 From the dropdown menu select the beta branch tilted: beta_flight
 Press the blue “Opt into beta_flight…” button
 In your Games Library click on Forever Skies [beta_flight]
 Install the Test Branch

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/61c2d01e45be73613aaa00be562f736b47406c25.png

How To Create and Load Existing Saves into the Test Branch


 Your existing saves for the main game are stored in a different folder compared to your saves on the test branch. If you want to continue and test the game using your existing progress, you’ll need to do the following:
 Locate your save files on your PC. By default they should be stored in the following file path:
 C:\Users\\AppData\Local\ProjectZeppelin\Saved\SaveGames\
 Select the save file that you want to test your progress on, right-click, copy.
 Located your Test Branch save file folder. By default they should be stored in the following file path:
 C:\Users\\AppData\Local\ProjectZeppelin\Saved_BetaFlight\SaveGames\
 Paste your copied save file into this location
 As a precaution make a 2nd copy of your save file and paste it somewhere on your desktop or in a safe folder. This way you can ensure you have a clean, backup save just in case.


After you have done the above, you can start the Forever Skies Test Branch from Steam and your save will be present when you select “CONTINUE”

Existing Saves Won’t be Affected but use an Imported Save To Play the Test Branch

Your existing saves, progress, and any custom settings you’ve set in from the main game won’t be carried over to the Test Branch. Your pc will see this as if you are installing and playing the game for the first time ever. Likewise, by playing on the Test Branch, your main saves should not be affected at all.

This also means any progress on the test branch will not be carried over to the main game once the update is live. The test branch is designed to allow you to explore and test new features without impacting your current progress.

Players can opt to play the test branch starting a fresh save, however, if you want to test new content with your existing progress, airship, etc (and we suggest you do) you will need to make a copy of your main game save and import it into the test branch. Instructions on how to do it can be found below.

Where to Submit Bugs

All bugs or issues that you encounter while playing should be submitted via the FEEDBACK TOOL that you can find in-game when pausing the game. Subsequently, you can find the tool under this link too:

https://www.farfromhomegames.com/en/playtests

You can also submit bugs and keep up to date on features via our Feature Upvote site -
https://forever-skies.featureupvote.com/

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

That's all for now. And a reminder to please fill in the survey once you've played! 

🔽CombatT Feedback Survey🔽
https://forms.gle/mTj9K4Hm8wEnLN6G6

This will also be pinned in our discussion board for you to fill in later.

Speak soon!

- Team Far From Home

“Pet the bug” is a feature we have planned and made public since we released our first roadmap in June 2023, but we didn’t want to just stop there.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/9a0cb3b5785eb601f01d244387ca0995bcba4624.gif

Players will be able to customize their pet with a fancy hat, a backpack and a harness in a few different colours. We plan on adding more customization options as development progresses.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/ebf455b896d833779894f07c030bb62862deb6e0.gif

The hat and harness options are purely cosmetic. They add to the bugs wholesome aesthetic but thats all. However, we hope the backpack will be a game changer for players. Give your pet this attachment from the customization menu and have it join you on your adventures away from the airship. 

Your pockets getting full while you explore? Off-load some of those resources into your pet’s backpack. The total number of slots available is not final and will be balanced throughout the beta phase. Eventually, we would love to have a range of backpack upgrades with increasing slots.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/67e5665100775dd027ca63e8d25f200d6fafdda7.gif

New Airship Decor

EA.1.5.3 isn’t just about your pet, as we have also added some new Airship decorations and a new room module.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/934484d8b4944aeeb9370eb2334c8b41b801a22e.gif

We have added a new Stairs Room Module, a Kingsize Bed that recovers your energy levels quicker and more!

EA.1.5.3 will also include Japanese and Korean localization!

ALL of this content is available RIGHT NOW on our beta branch. Instructions on how to join can be found at the bottom of this blog. We will be adding more content throughout the beta, such as interior lighting decor range, Kickstarter rewards if you were one of our backers and more!

------------------------------------------------------------

BETA PATCH NOTES

NEW CONTENT:

Pet:

 Friendly Insect “Pet” interaction added
 Friendly Insect companion can follow the player during exploration
 Friendly Insect companion, while equipped with backpack, unlocks additional inventory slots
 Friendly Insect companion can be customized

Pet Customization:

 Basic set of pet’s equipment is unlocked when the Friendly Insect is first placed on the Soft Cushion
 Crafting recipes available through a new set of Data Cards (green)
 Three colored sets of the Pet’s outfits (cap, shoes and backpack)

Tools & Devices:

 Amber King Size Bed - enhances the sleeping process
 Crystal Lamp (left and right)
 Sprinkler Lamp

Airship:

 Stair Room

Resources:

 Neon plant

Localization:

 Japanese
 Korean

CHANGED:

 Soft Cushion trigger for opening pet’s equipment screen

FIXED:

 Pig Smile Seeds icon fixed so it can match all the other small plant seeds
 Proper Advanced Pass Component icon implemented

KNOWN ISSUES:

 Friendly Insect can follow the player only while the airship is docked (lands on a location’s platform). This means the pet won’t follow you while the Airship is in the air and when visiting locations accessed via the Docking Plank. We are currently working on this and will implement the fix soon.
 Using Quick Move (Shift+Click), the player can move items from their inventory to the Friendly Insect’s inventory even if a pet’s backpack wasn’t crafted yet. These items can be accessed after the pet’s backpack is equipped.
 There is currently no boiled version of the Neon Plant. 
 Localization for non-English languages is still work in progress and will be updated before this update goes live on main (leaves beta)
 Textures are currently missing from Stairs Room module, the pets yellow outfit and Crystal Lamp
 Icons for the new lamps, Neon Plant, and the Stair Room missing


---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
How To Access the Test Branch

 Open the Steam application on your PC and locate Forever Skies in your games library
 Right click - PROPERTIES- BETAS
 Put in the password: BlimpWorkshop
 From the dropdown menu select the beta branch tilted: beta_flight
 Press the blue “Opt into beta_flight…” button
 In your Games Library click on Forever Skies [beta_flight]
 Install the Test Branch

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/61c2d01e45be73613aaa00be562f736b47406c25.png

How To Create and Load Existing Saves into the Test Branch

Your existing saves for the main game are stored in a different folder compared to your saves on the test branch. If you want to continue and test the game using your existing progress, you’ll need to do the following:

 Locate your save files on your PC. By default they should be stored in the following file path:
 C:\Users\\AppData\Local\ProjectZeppelin\Saved\SaveGames\
 Select the save file that you want to test your progress on, right-click, copy.
 Located your Test Branch save file folder. By default they should be stored in the following file path:

Players can opt to play the test branch starting a fresh save, however, if you want to test new content with your existing progress, airship, etc (and we suggest you do) you will need to make a copy of your main game save and import it into the test branch. notes.title: “Crafting & Fuelling” Patch Now Live + New Bundle Offer!
notes.notes:
Greetings scientists!

Patch EA.1.5.2 is now live and includes a bunch of new features and we just launched a bundle with fellow mobile base survivalists Volcanoids!

Volcanoids x Forever Skies Bundle is Available 
First off, we've partnered on a bundle with our good friends behind Volcanoids. Volcanoids is a fantastic base-building, open-world survival shooter that replaces your typical base with a mobile, giant drill. 

And you know we're all fans of mobile bases here! Alone or with friends, explore an island plagued by eruptions, upgrade your drill, and fight robots to uncover what's been hiding beneath the surface.

If you already own Forever Skies you can grab an extra 15% using our bundle. Click below.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/41771/Volcanoids_x_Forever_Skies

What's Been Added in the New Update?
Alright, so let's get into what’s new! Here is a quick overview with more details for each further down.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/563a9255f51e5f8174428609f7463282d9fabf74.png

Craft From Storage
We heard your feedback! With EA.1.5.2, players can now craft items directly from all storage boxes on your Airship. This QOL improvement will save players a lot of time finding where they placed that last Polymer piece!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/2a317f316cfb456612931e88bf7489fe9be2dabf.png

We have also updated the UI to show players what and how many resources they have in their inventory & storage total when crafting.

This option can be turned off in the settings for those who prefer a more traditional survival game experience

Fuel Tank
The tank holds up to 400 units of fuel at a time and can be placed anywhere on your airship, meaning you no longer have to run to each individual Upgraded Engine to refuel it, all fuel types can be placed inside.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/a4da611de59c912d9d5fc20312dd284d030f4932.png

This new Airship item can be found at the Overgrown Lift location and becomes craftable once you have the Upgrade Station (for now). With one Fuel Tank, players can connect pipes from the tank to two Upgraded Engines using the same pipe system as airship gardening.

We have also introduced the Cross-Pipe which gives you the ability to overlap pipes and provides more freedom when placing them.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/625693f83144fd305ed3f19454d03eae4b7ae395.png

We need to hear your thoughts after trying this new system! Does it help? Does it make refuelling your Airship easier? What improvements would you like to see? Let us know…

Moth Aquarium
Introducing the Moth Aquarium! I guess it’s technically a Vivarium? But you get the point! With this new decoration, you can keep any moths you catch alive for decoration (or consumption, no judgement, a scientists gotta eat!)

We would love to do more with the Aquarium in the future, (breeding, anyone?) but for now this will look great in your on-board your airship!

Also, look how those little guys come alive when you turn on your Flashlight.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/dd5f3d2bc364a91f39520d5b833d1a7321934310.gif

Bloom Exterior Modules & Decorative Wings
EA.1.5.2 adds to the Bloom range by including new Exterior Bloom Modules. Such as a new Catwalk style and a couple of new railing designs!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/840fce3c7482833860252cdd38cc594bfbadd962.png

We have also added additional decorative wings. These can be placed anywhere on the outside of your airship providing there is space. 

They won’t help you survive the world or navigate the skies. You don’t exactly *need* them to complete your objectives either, but they will sure make your airship exterior look way cooler!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/7e62f60525081ee198711f8fcc128be60c0b5e0b.png

New Upgrade Station
The Upgrade Station gets…well…upgraded in EA.1.5.2, just like how the Ship Workstation did last month. This station which is used to upgrade your Airship and personal tech, now has a brand new model and animation.

It's a small change in the game, but we hope these small changes improve your overall experience when playing Forever Skies!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/4455929038beeeb93c87f382b14fadc43eca0396.png

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Patch Notes

Here are the full patch notes for EA.1.5.2:

NEW CONTENT:

Devices:

 Fuel Tank
 Aquarium for Moths
 Cross pipes 
 Airship:
 Bloom Catwalk
 Bloom High Railing (left and right)

notes.title: Patch EA.1.5.1 "Gardening Plus" Now Live!
notes.notes:
Greetings scientists,

Patch EA.1.5.1 (Build #28037) has been beta-tested for nearly two weeks, and is now live on our main branch!

This patch is made up of content that wasn’t quite ready in time for the Airship Gardening update (EA.1.5.0) at the end of March. With so much content going into the last update, some assets had to be temporarily cut due to time constraints. But that's not the case anymore, here they are!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/e094b33fd268217c3cff5f89920ba6bf5c13d510.png

Seven New Cockpit Styles Added

A lot of players tell us that they love customizing their Airship and want more modules to play around and experiment with.

You also keep telling us you want stairs…

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/413fc8bb49e5c5d6e5b910f74b3a5d7f6bf2e9eb.gif

The new Bloom Cockpit Range is definitely worth checking out with their unique 2-floor design, complete with stairs. They’re available in 1-wide, 2-wide and 3-wide variants. They don’t even need to be used as a cockpit, as they also make a nice open and spacious room for your airship base. Instead, why not choose from some of the other new cockpit modules?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/913a545b504fb6ea4403929701496e2110232fd8.gif

You asked for it, we heard you…introducing the Inverted cockpit range! For those of you who prefer a more traditional airship cockpit design, an inverted variant can now be unlocked in the game. As before, they are available in 1, 2 and 3-wide (we have also added a 3-wide normal cockpit too)

Now there are even more options to make your Airship base uniquelly yours. We won’t be stopping here either, as more modules are currently in development.

Water Pipe Sockets

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/ef6b2d77a05129cf28500c566f230a6e58dcaca5.png

Now players can pass water through walls using Pipe Sockets. These now automatically unlock when players scan the Water Pipes at the Infected Garden location. Water Generators can now only be placed outside (as intended) and using the new Sockets, water can travel from the Generator outside, into your Airship Garden room on the inside. It also means your Airship can have more than one garden room, without having to create two separate Gardening systems.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/de45f2e03016117e24adac32be8404eccf6b9cd0.png

New Localization: Portuguese - Brazil

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/c66b1d87ebc1844a15a0e8e0df31934ac23892cf.png

Portuguese - Brazil is the latest language to be added. We will not stop here, there are still languages we plan to localize Forever Skies into. Please let us know which ones you would like to see.

Visual Improvements

We continue to make small improvements to the visuals and audio of the game which we hope will lead to a better experience overall for players.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/d6d2ca8a5fe05675b1ae549a82d1442806b8b46f.gif

We have added an animation for when players consume a Booster in-game. It’s only a small thing, but we hope it adds to the experience.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/c6b30e8a8218fff070abdd836b4badf6a1038dcd.png

Another visual improvement we made was to the model and animation of the Ship Workstation. The old model has always been a placeholder in our minds, we believe the updated model is to the correct standard now. What do you think about these changes?

SFX Improvements

We have made some audio improvements with EA.1.5.1 too. Probably the most noticeable improvement are BREATHING NOISES!

Yes, our scientist now sounds a lot less…robotic…when they are out of breath, which is a much-needed change. Other audio additions with this patch include SFX for the Distiller, ambient sounds in the Underdust - Suburbs, sounds added to the “Discovering Noah cutscene” and more. 

Here are the full patch notes for EA.1.5.1

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

NEW CONTENT:

Devices:

 Pipe Sockets study recipe added after scanning Pipes (should be present in Research Station if Pipes were scanned already)

Airship:

 Large Cockpit
 Small Cockpit - Inverted
 Cockpit - Inverted  
 Large Cockpit - Inverted 
 Small Bloom Two-Deck Cockpit
 Bloom Two-Deck Cockpit
 Large Bloom Two-Deck Cockpit
 Reducing Balloons option 

Player:

 Booster usage animation

Other:

 Brazilian Portuguese localization added
 Medical Reagent printing animation added
 “Mods detected” main menu notification added

CHANGED:

 HUD - critical stamina level animation will now play when stamina was depleted to 30%
 Spoiling timers for stacked items logic changed - while splitting stacks, the timer stays on split items and resets on an initial stack
 Ship Workstation device model and animations changed
 Aircutter knife now uses power and needs recharging
 Water Condenser Membrane has to be collected and thus recycled for a small amount of Synthetics when it’s done with condensing 5 stacks of water
 Flashlight quick move from Charger places it in its dedicated slot instead of empty inventory slot
 Preternatural Branches on Infected Greenhouse Towers play a sound alert whenever the player gets too close to them
 Pipe Water Generator can now only be placed outside as originally intended (players use Pipe Sockets to bring water from the outside)
 Pipes visuals improved - when the connection is right, LED arrows will light too
 Garden Pots and Cooking Pot do not need bottles anymore - adding water doesn’t lock bottle inside those devices
 Database - Infected Gnarls and Infected Roots descriptions split into Active and Neutralized entries
 Fabricator - Boosters tab renamed to Health
 First Aid Kit moved to the Health tab in Fabricator
 Additional sprinklers chained in serial connections sprays water quicker
 Devices with item slots, e.g. Virus Sample Analyzer now only allow you to put one item inside instead of stack
 Lift storage boxes quick move and sorting options added
 Distiller SFX added
 Underdust - Suburbs ambient sounds added and improved
 Underdust - Suburbs paths and POIs visibility improved
 Overgrown Tower paths visibility improved
 Oxygen supply refilled after Underdust: Tunnels cutscene, this encourages players to explore further without having to rush back for oxygen
 Fixed bug that would allow Energy values to rise above the maximum value while sleeping
 Fixed rare bug blocking using keypads while Airship Builder menu was opened and closed
 Noah’s body cutscene sounds added
 Detecting mod files being used and including such info in crash reports
 Added missing translations

FIXED: 

 Database - Health entry updated with current HUD changes
 Database - Coffee Nut description fixed - it can’t be eaten raw without any threat
 Studies - Wrecked Big Gardening Pot can now be found on both Greenhouse Tower and Overgrown Tower locations
 Studies - Hardened Creepers could be found on Underdust: Suburbs location only
 Distiller device cannot be damaged and shouldn’t show 0% health status anymore
 Pipe Water Generator collisions restored
 Pipe Water Membrane now shouldn’t change to regular Water Condenser Membrane upon Pipe Water Generator pickup or after loading a save
 Pipes change their color when Water Tank runs empty
 Rare issue where airship didn’t react to Rudder interactions and couldn’t fly unless player left and returned aboard fixed
 Fixed - Few paints with broken textures on certain airship modules 
 Glass Shards from Greenhouse Tower locations saves properly after cut down
 Broken Crate shows its broken state mesh until it’s repaired
 Fixed issue where stackable items removed from devices with a resource slot, e.g. Virus Sample Analyzer, couldn’t stack anymore
 Fixed issue where stackable items transferred from devices with a resource slot, e.g. Virus Sample Analyzer, ended with losing whole stack of those items when inventory was full already
 Missing Moth Swarm sounds restored
 Reverb sometimes heard in open spaces fixed
 SFX volumes remixed in places to address volume spike issues
 Performance issues improved
 The player character should now sound less robotic
 Friendly Insect highlights when it can be scanned
 Poster “Automatic Irrigation System” highlights when it can be scanned
 Numerous smaller fixes for the pipe building

KNOWN ISSUES: 

 Playing hand animation while interacting with Rudder or Deck Extractor while having a tool equipped
 Player model detaching from the camera while using Deck Extractor, sometimes leading to the player falling off their Airship AKA death.
 If you aim the crossbow and crouch, your character’s walk and run speed will be intensely slowed down
 Mydriasis Inhibitor missing on Infected Garden locations, despite the item being shown in the Studies menu
 Fertilizer in the Small Pot never ends, and the icon shows 6/5 units inside the bottle
 Shift+Clicking on an item in a toolbar while being in a Fabricator/Upgrade Station/Ship Workstation/Distiller menu will result in losing the item
 Cooking Station’s water capacity exceeds the limit of 20
 Pipes are not showing the connection to the device and the water flow (despite it being already established and working) after saving and loading the game
 Big Gardening Pot doesn’t have a “Remove Plant” function


-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Thats all for now, we will have more news to share with you next week!
Team Far From Home

Thats all of the changes for now. We're still working on additional fixes and improvements...
-------------------------------------------------------------

How To Access the Test Branch

 Open the Steam application on your PC and locate Forever Skies in your games library
 Right click - PROPERTIES- BETAS
 Put in the password: BlimpWorkshop
 From the dropdown menu select the beta branch tilted: beta_flight
 Press the blue “Opt into beta_flight…” button
 In your Games Library click on Forever Skies [beta_flight]
 Install the Test Branch

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/61c2d01e45be73613aaa00be562f736b47406c25.png

How To Create and Load Existing Saves into the Test Branch

Your existing saves for the main game are stored in a different folder compared to your saves on the test branch. If you want to continue and test the game using your existing progress, you’ll need to do the following:

 Locate your save files on your PC. By default they should be stored in the following file path:
 C:\Users\\AppData\Local\ProjectZeppelin\Saved\SaveGames\
 Select the save file that you want to test your progress on, right-click, copy.
 Located your Test Branch save file folder. By default they should be stored in the following file path:
 C:\Users\\AppData\Local\ProjectZeppelin\Saved_BetaFlight\SaveGames\
 Paste your copied save file into this location
 As a precaution make a 2nd copy of your save file and paste it somewhere on your desktop or in a safe folder. This way you can ensure you have a clean, backup save just in case.

After you have done the above, you can start the Forever Skies Test Branch from Steam and your save will be present when you select “CONTINUE”

Existing Saves Won’t be Affected but use an Imported Save To Play the Test Branch

Your existing saves, progress, and any custom settings you’ve set in from the main game won’t be carried over to the Test Branch. Your pc will see this as if you are installing and playing the game for the first time ever. Likewise, by playing on the Test Branch, your main saves should not be affected at all.

This also means any progress on the test branch will not be carried over to the main game once the update is live. The test branch is designed to allow you to explore and test new features without impacting your current progress.

Players can opt to play the test branch starting a fresh save, however, if you want to test new content with your existing progress, airship, etc (and we suggest you do) you will need to make a copy of your main game save and import it into the test branch. Instructions on how to do it can be found below.

Where to Submit Bugs

All bugs or issues that you encounter while playing should be submitted via the FEEDBACK TOOL that you can find in-game when pausing the game. You can also access it here.

Thats all for now, speak soon!

notes.title: Airship Gardening Update Is Live!
notes.notes:
Greetings scientists!

As per the title, our largest-ever update, “Airship Gardening” is now live for all. Below are some of the key new features and improvements you can expect from EA.1.5.0.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/ace0cdf9dad15a0e5481935ce3f72ad7bd96dc78.png

This is by far the largest update we’ve released since the start of Early Access. 

Our team have been working hard on this update since the launch of The Frozen Wishes Update back in December, and there is a lot to see!

Saves

We would highly recommend players start a brand new game to fully experience every new change and addition included in the Airship Gardening update. Such as improved story, locations and world improvements. Your old saves will still work, just you will experience the flow of the new content a little differently. 

Your rewards from the Frozen Wishes update are no longer tied to your save files. This means if you unlocked the rewards from the festive quest back in December, they will carry over and be unlockable in any new save you create.

Here is a breakdown of the main additions you can expect from this update and the full patch notes…

Airship Gardening Mechanics

Gardening will play an important role in the game loop, but also the story. If you wish to keep your gardening setup simple and just grow a few crops for food and for the story, you can totally do that. But if you want to go all out with these mechanics and make the most of this mechanic, it’s safe to say you should be able to create some really impressive floating greenhouses!

You will be able to add water tanks, a Distiller for different fertilizers, different size pots, a network of pipes, sprinklers and more!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/7b170a06f67e3cf3ef88ddbe42892b0dc6ad8ae4.gif

Different pieces of the new gardening tech can be found in several places across our procedurally generated world. Some of the more basic equipment like pots and water tanks are easier to find as they’re placed in more than one location. However, the more advanced technology like Distillers and Water Generators are a tad more rare. Be sure to check your Studies Menu!

In most cases, you will need to plant the seed for the item you want to grow. This process is relatively pain-free as all perishable items like food, medicine and plants now stack in your inventory.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/7cf969fda6877e0aed81a0d1ec434af73fbaeaba.gif

You can increase the speed at which a plant grows by adding a special fertilizer from the Distiller. This fertilizer is made from Rotten Food (yes, it now has a purpose, yay!) Plants that only grow in the Underdust like Breathnuts and more can also be grown, providing you craft the Dust Fertilizer and add it to the garden pot.

Story Chapter 2 - Hunt For The Cure

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/faba426a3f730c2134f2a234c171dba1db94eb19.png

CHAPTER 1 RECAP / SPOILERS AHEAD!

The first chapter of our story came to an end with the Viral Evolution update. We found what was left of Noah in the Underdust, followed by his research in the Infected Gardens. With that research we were able to craft a hologram which provided the coordinates to the location of the cure that we have been looking for - as was Noah and the previous expedition before us.

As we mentioned before, gardening will play a role in the next section of the story. In addition, we will also be taking our next trip back down to the surface of the planet.

New Underdust Section - Suburbs

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/ba75f31cfc7e6317c2a6a6eecd381f83bb3008fc.gif

This update features a brand new Underdust map for players to explore, The Suburbs. Players will head here during this latest chapter in search of the elusive cure. This map is roughly 4-times larger than the first Underdust map in Chapter 1 and a lot more open. Thankfully, there are a few landmarks to help players get their bearings in this foggy biome AND a Large Oxygen Bottle to make exploration a lot easier.

We hope you have fun down there!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/d788d20aafffde0d72b06341b73ba6a924abc874.gif

Down here you will find a lot of new useful items to collect and new blueprints to research and craft. Including new plant seeds, organic substances for special fertilizers, blueprints for Gardening technology and a new upgraded version of the knife, the Aircutter.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/21f441a8baa84aa6c2de3321c94239baae33a5ad.png

A side note on combat…

With a new exciting Underdust biome to explore, Im sure that many players were hoping to exchange blows with Mantis enemies and more with this update. However, we made the difficult decision to temporarily hold off on this feature, but only for now…

While we have got combat working in the development stages, we weren’t 100% happy with it and so have decided to spend more time on this feature so it can be better. We keep a watchful eye on other survival games and so we know how passionate survival game players are about this being done right, which is why this decision was made. In addition, we don’t want combat to be isolated in just this one location, we want it to be bigger and better, so some of our team will be focusing on this after the launch of the Airship Gardening update.

Improved World & Story Progression

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/b12c726044790ac6ca3235e477eb3f4815f0f2b9.png

Not only have we added new story and content with this update, we have also gone back and made improvements to the world and story that already existed in Forever Skies. This was done to make gameplay more fun and make the story easier to understand. The following was done thanks to your incredible feedback:

 Many mission objectives re-written to give players a better and more immersive experience
 Mission Reports - summarizing main quest milestones for the player upon returning to the airship from main quest locations
 More lore scenes added 
 Story-related voice lines - from the players "suit AI" added
 New cutscenes
 Design, art and gameplay improvements to existing locations like Radio Towers, Overgrown Radio Towers, Gardens & Descent Lifts.
 City ruins improved visually

Again, we highly recommend players start a fresh save to fully experience all of the above changes. However, if players wish to simply continue from the previous saves and continue the story from where it left off then this is also possible. Your rewards from the Frozen Wishes Update will no longer be affected!

New Airship Module Design - “Bloom Range” 

Airship customization is important in Forever Skies. Because of this, we have added our first new Airship modules, the “Bloom Range”. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/6191a3e3dbdf5168ae2baa91d0354ab680bbe157.png

These modules can be found on our re-worked data card system - more details below in the full patch notes. We are only getting started with new modules. Coming soon we plan to add additional modules like new cockpits, balloons, exterior modules, stairs and more!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/e23ff2ad2f2054fce89af7fdfe93073e3b2af4e6.gif

Airship Gardening introduces a new cleaner HUD design to players. We decided to update our HUD for a few important reasons:

 With the changes made to Immunity a few months ago thanks to your feedback, the immunity Circle on the HUD became redundant as it was no longer a mechanic you would have to manage. Instead, immunity is now tied to the story and will change as a scripted event. Your current immunity status can now be found on the Inventory screen.
 Cleaner and easier to understand. Certain icons were not explained well in the old design, such as using boosters or diseases. The new HUD displays this in a much clearer manner
 Player parameters with distinguished Stamina/Energy and Radiation Zone alerts. 

Please let us know your thoughts on the HUD changes. Do you prefer them? Is it an improvement? We’re listening!

A side note on The Flashlight…

We made some changes to how players acquire the Flashlight in a recent update, EA.1.4.2, and again with this latest update, EA.1.5.0. 

We realise that this might have caused some confusion to players over the last few weeks, which we apologize for. So for any players wondering where to find the Flashlight with this new update, to confirm, it can now be found on a dead expedition member on any basic Radio Tower. Check your Studies Menu.

Look out for the signature blue cable, the Flashlight is on top of the corpse.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/5231b1cd091f193c1180819fa27da1bb7bb6170b.png

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

There are more additions and changes we could go into more detail about, so instead, we have compiled them here in the full patch notes:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/d788d20aafffde0d72b06341b73ba6a924abc874.gif

Down here you will find a lot of new useful items to collect and new blueprints to research and craft. Including new plants seeds, organic substances for special fertilizers and blueprints for Gardening technology and a new upgraded version of the knife, the Aircutter.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/21f441a8baa84aa6c2de3321c94239baae33a5ad.png

A side note on combat…

With a new exciting Underdust biome to explore, Im sure that many players were hoping to exchange blows with Mantis enemies and more with this update. However, we made the difficult decision to temporarily hold off on this feature, but only for now…

While we have got combat working in the development stages, we weren’t 100% happy with it and so have decided to spend more time on this feature so it can be better. We keep a watchful eye on other survival games and so we know how passionate survival game players are about this being done right, which is why this decision was made. In addition, we don’t want combat to be isolated in just this one location, we want it to be bigger and better, and so our team will be focusing on this after the launch of the Airship Gardening update.

Improved World & Story Progression

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/b12c726044790ac6ca3235e477eb3f4815f0f2b9.png

Not only have we added new story and content with this update, we have also gone back and made improvements to the world and story that already existed in Forever Skies. This was done to make gameplay more engaging and make the story easier to understand. The following was done thanks to your incredible feedback:

 Many mission objectives re-written to give players a better and more immersive experience
 Mission Reports - summarizing main quest milestones for the player upon returning to the airship from main quest locations
 More lore scenes added 
 Story related AI voice lines added
 New cutscenes
 Design, art and gameplay improvements to existing locations like Radio Towers, Overgrown Radio Towers, Gardens & Descent Lifts.
 Several city ruins improved visually

Again, we highly recommend players start a fresh save to fully experience all of the above changes. However, if players wish to simply continue from the previous saves and continue the story from where it left off then this is also possible, you just might not experience all of the listed changes above.

New Airship Module Design - “Serenity Range” 

Airship customization is important in Forever Skies. Because of this, we have added our first new Airship modules, the “Serenity Range”. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/6191a3e3dbdf5168ae2baa91d0354ab680bbe157.png

These modules can be found on our re-worked data card system - more details below in the full patch notes. We are only getting started with new modules. Coming soon we plan to add additional modules like new cockpits, balloons, exterior modules, stairs and more!

Introducing A New HUD/UI Design

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/e23ff2ad2f2054fce89af7fdfe93073e3b2af4e6.gif

Airship Gardening introduces a new cleaner HUD design to players. We decided to update our HUD for a few reasons:

 With the changes made to Immunity a few months ago thanks to player feedback, the Immunity Circle on the HUD became redundant as it was no longer a mechanic you would have to manage. Instead immunity is now tied to the story and will change as a scripted event. Your current immunity status can now be found on the Inventory screen.
 Cleaner and easier to understand. Certain icons were not explained well in the old design, such as using boosters or diseases. The new HUD displays this in a much clearer manner
 Player parameters with distinguished Stamina/Energy and Radiation Zone alerts. 

Please let us know your thoughts on the HUD changes. Do you prefer them? Is it an improvement? We’re listening!

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The Full Changelog

There are more additions and changes we could go into more detail about, so instead, we have compiled them here in the full patch notes:

Player:

Other:

How To Access the Test Branch

 Open the Steam application on your PC and locate Forever Skies in your games library

How To Create and Load Existing Saves into the Test Branch

Your existing saves for the main game are stored in a different folder compared to your saves on the test branch. If you want to continue and test the game using your existing progress, you’ll need to do the following:

 Locate your save files on your PC. By default they should be stored in the following file path:
 C:\Users\\AppData\Local\ProjectZeppelin\Saved\SaveGames\
 Select the save file that you want to test your progress on, right-click, copy.
 Located your Test Branch save file folder. By default they should be stored in the following file path:
 C:\Users\\AppData\Local\ProjectZeppelin\Saved_BetaFlight\SaveGames\

Players can opt to play the test branch starting a fresh save, however, if you want to test new content with your existing progress, airship, etc (and we suggest you do) you will need to make a copy of your main game save and import it into the test branch. notes.title: Early Access Ends in 2024 | Quality-Of-Life Patch (EA.1.4.2) Is Out Now!
notes.notes:
Greetings scientists!

We have quite a few bits of news to share with you today, so buckle up!

1. EARLY ACCESS PLANNED TO COMPLETE IN 2024

Today we announced that our team is on-track to release the full version of Forever Skies in late 2024. 

We don’t have an exact day and month for you yet because we ourselves will only know that closer to the end of development. We also need to see how the work and feedback on our next big updates go. But rest assured, once we know and feel the date works for our team we will announce it.

And yes, co-op is still planned to be added before the release of the final version. Our work there is progressing well but we are still adamant that it will be released once we feel it is ready.

2. WE HAVE PARTNERED WITH SONY

Our next big news is that we have partnered with Sony! We have actually been quietly working with them for a few years but today we can make it official. 

With their help we have been able to focus on making Forever Skies the best it can be for its console debut. So, at the end of PC Early Access when we're ready to release the full game, we'll be launching it exclusively on PlayStation 5 for consoles and Steam on the same day. 

We released a new trailer and got a cool story on PS Blog about the inspiration behind the game. You can check out both here:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/74fce3851491a89c6fdcfd508c5b6653ae095861.png
[previewyoutube=jNrhydUfH_I;full][/previewyoutube]

3. 20% SALE + RIFTBREAKER BUNDLE

Along with the news and new patch (see the bulk below) we’ve got a 20% sale on Steam right now. We also have our ongoing bundle with The Riftbreaker live still. 

The Riftbreaker is what would happen if Diablo and Starcraft had a baby. Mechs, base-building, survival, and hack-and-slash combat all in one. You are an elite scientist/commando inside an advanced Mecha-Suit sent to terraform a hostile alien planet. Hack & slash swarms of enemies, build up your base, collect samples, and research new inventions to survive.

If you already own Forever Skies you can use the bundle to get an additional 15% off from The Riftbreaker

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/37896/FOREVER_SKIES_X_THE_RIFTBREAKER/

4. NEW QUALITY OF LIFE PATCH IS LIVE!

The Quality-Of-Life patch - EA.1.4.2 ha arrived and includes QOL improvements, bug fixes and gives much-needed love to the forgotten tool of Forever Skies, The Flashlight!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/fec50d95b8557a1a4eaf5a79a491a3b50d1eee9c.gif

New(ish) Item: The Flashlight

Finally, after 7 months in Early Access all players will know that they can use a Flashlight in game!

The blueprint for this tool can be acquired early on after visiting your first Radio Tower and collecting some Electrical Parts. This will prompt the blueprint to unlock, at which point the player can research it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/6ccf01becacbd35427b313564cf86f558df6c4c2.gif

Players don’t need to worry about another item taking up valuable inventory space as The Flashlight gets its own dedicated slot, in the same way as your Oxygen Tank. It now runs on batteries and will need to be charged like most tools.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/73a15a9f29459f7a103f2e4eb3e725b8ff209097.gif

QOL Improvement: Airship Base Adjustments

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/d6de9d58dbd95de143b99580be6c7d534419475e.gif

If you’re replacing any normal wall module with a Door, then any attachments you had on the wall will simply drop into your inventory, unless you’re inventory is full. And with Patch 1.4.2, that just got easier too!

QOL Improvement: Inventory Management

Your inventory, storage boxes, and freezers have had a couple of new functions added to make moving items around easier than ever.

Store All - This will remove all items currently in your inventory and move them into the storage box/freezer that you’re interacting with.

Take All - This will move all items in that Storage Box or Freezer into your Inventory.

Sort - This one is self-explanatory, it will sort all of your items so slots are more organized and will group stacks of the same item together.

Store Similar - This function is useful when you have a Storage Box for a specific resource. It will remove the item or resource out of your inventory that matches the item or resource that’s already in the Storage Box, meaning you don’t have to comb through your inventory to find that stack of Machine Parts you want to store. It can be done at the click of a button once you interact with your Machine Parts Storage Box.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/d91f566d4b0a19d134fd21c0494497d22b12f9b0.gif

----------------------------------------------------------

Full Patch Notes:


New elements:

 Flashlight added as an equipable and rechargeable player’s tool


QoL improvements:


 Inventory sorting and stacking added, also in various containers
 “Deposit All” option added - the ability to deposit all container-specific items into a container with a single click
 “Deposit Similar” - the ability to deposit all items from the Inventory that are of the same type as the items in the container.
 “Take All” option added - the ability to take all items from a single container into inventory
 Changes to the quest progression in the Underdust location:
- Most of the sub-quests were rewritten to give a better understanding of the quest progression

- Removed Battery used to power up the lift in the Descent to the Underdust location

- Path to the Lab in the Underdust should be more accessible

- Lab section slightly changed, e.g. Medical Reagents, crucial in the progression, are more exposed 

- Dead Virus Carrier lore tablet, crucial in the progression, is more exposed


 Airship wall and floor types can now be changed without the need to remove attached devices and artifacts (which previously blocked such changes)
 Interaction with the Cooking Station should now be accessible only from the front of the device
 Note Sticker - action buttons switched - holding E now enters edit mode
 Immunity Booster now blocks any new virus infections for its duration
 While being infected with any given virus, another infection with the same virus resets its timer
 Thunderstorms should now be less frequent (approx. twice less often)
 Database - locations’ entries’ background images added
 Basic Engine Thrusters’ visuals improved
 Boiled Lulling Grass Cricket’s icon changed to differentiate it more from the raw Cricket
 Boiled Dust Lettuce’s icon changed to differentiate it more from the raw Lettuce
 The Chromatic Aberration toggle option was added to the Settings 
 Thunderstorm volume slider added to the Audio Settings


Fixes:


 Flying debris can’t damage an airship, while it’s docked at the Descent to the Underdust location
 The player no longer dies after using the Medical Station while being infected with Hemorrhagic Fever
 Storage Boxes cannot be placed on other Storage Boxes anymore
 Insect Catcher no longer works when it’s in collision with parts of locations
 Damaged Upgraded Turbines no longer reset their health state upon being picked up
 To-Do list no longer marks already-seen tasks as new
 Souvenir Mug’s icon now matches the in-game mesh
 Thorn Bee Hives placement fixed - they shouldn’t spawn in strange places anymore
 Music tracks should play and change while exploring various locations
 A glass wall with door frame scanning description fixed
 Breathnut descriptions now show how much oxygen it replenishes
 Immunity is reset to the proper value after the player dies
 Minor typos in text fixed


Known issues:


 Shadows flicker badly while an airship is moving (the more noticeable the lower quality settings)
 Some broken crates may appear as not damaged
 Database - some icons are missing in the locations’ entries


That's all for now! 
Team Far From Home

How To Access the Test Branch

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/77700a99e25b4c21ab3566232fdab27fd15820c0.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/83781dbba7c3ee87d802ed3187589b8b2df9bc45.jpg

How To Create and Load Existing Saves into the Test Branch

Your existing saves for the main game are stored in a different folder compared to your saves on the test branch. If you want to continue and test the game using your existing progress, you’ll need to do the following:


 Locate your save files on your PC. By default they should be stored in the following file path:
C:\Users\\AppData\Local\ProjectZeppelin\Saved\SaveGames\
 Select the save file that you want to test your progress on, right-click, copy.
 Located your Test Branch save file folder. By default they should be stored in the following file path:
C:\Users\\AppData\Local\ProjectZeppelin\Saved_BetaFlight\SaveGames\
 Paste your copied save file into this location
 As a precaution make a 2nd copy of your save file and paste it somewhere on your desktop or in a safe folder. This way you can ensure you have a clean, backup save just in case.


After you have done the above, you can start the Forever Skies Test Branch from Steam and your save will be present when you select “CONTINUE”


Existing Saves Won’t be Affected but use an Imported Save To Play the Test Branch

Your existing saves, progress, and any custom settings you’ve set in from the main game won’t be carried over to the Test Branch. Your pc will see this as if you are installing and playing the game for the first time ever. Likewise, by playing on the Test Branch, your main saves should not be affected at all.

This also means any progress on the test branch will not be carried over to the main game once the update is live. The test branch is designed to allow you to explore and test new features without impacting your current progress.

Players can opt to play the test branch starting a fresh save, however, if you want to test new content with your existing progress, airship, etc (and we suggest you do) you will need to make a copy of your main game save and import it into the test branch. Instructions on how to do it can be found below.  

Where to Submit Bugs

All bugs or issues that you encounter while playing should be submitted via the FEEDBACK TOOL that you can find in-game when pausing the game. Subsequently, you can find the tool under this link too: 

https://www.farfromhomegames.com/en/playtests

The September patch - EA.1.2.0 (#23490) has finally arrived and includes some new items, fixes & QOL improvements!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/dafaf39bf664451386989f4680b2c6bfa4fb4939.png

NEW ITEM: The Repair Thrower

Finally, the upgrade for the humble Repair Patch has arrived in Forever Skies! Players can find the blueprint for the Repair Thrower in a new room in the Underdust biome, complete with its consumable “ammunition”, Repair Foam.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/b246ae85da67a56185033f2cf6ac188bea5bff15.gif

The Repair Thrower is a more advanced, methodical and satisfying method of fixing damage to your airship base, than the Repair Patch. This new tool even comes with a handy radar device at the back, that guides you to the damaged parts of your airship.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/1a4a1c6840441bb42e4be5b629770fd371b903ef.gif

New room added to the Underdust where you will find the tools blueprint and other useful items.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/a381c8b2cb2e6016152c9eb433d083afb85eda76.png

NEW ITEM: Damaged Boxes

You will now find boxes scattered around the world both above and below the dust. These boxes contain useful items inside. However, the box itself is damaged, meaning the player is unable to access the contents. These boxes will require fixing with Repair Foam first in order to claim the items inside!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/9e825a8c3363f1ef35971d96ded2dbac1bbc9d49.png

FIXED: Pet Now Obtainable If Missed

Tell me if this sounds familiar, you were exploring the tunnels in the Underdust until you were attacked by a Mantis. This caused a *mild* panic and you got out of dodge the first chance you got. Except wait, you later found out that the pet was not accessible to you because of your earlier *ahem* “tactical retreat”. Well fear no more, we have fixed this error. The pet can now be obtained if you missed it the first time! It can now be found waiting for you in the tunnel, just outside of where you first came across the Mantis’. So head on back to claim your new pet.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775446/f5e0bc71d949e84d7306636684ca6c00046e9d54.png

Remove HUD option has now been added! Now you can take screenshots of the beautifully damaged world, or perhaps your behemoth Airship without the HUD getting in the way!

Other improvements have been made to our UI, including improved stack splitting! Stacks now split in half, not just by single items.

 Repair Thrower and Repair Foam added
 Damaged boxes containing items added into gameloop

Fixes:
